text:
morgan: heads-up — after last rollout (v3.4.7) random smoke sampling shows a small cluster of failures in a ~7min window (21:33–21:40 UTC). not obvious from dashboards but synth sample fail rate jumped to ~6% for embed-route.
arjun: can you paste the deploy-bot summary?
deploy-bot: postdeploy-synth id=4781 route=embed-route samples=200 failed=12 p95_latency_ms=240 (+40ms vs baseline) flagged_at=1756789060
sasha: oof. 6% small but meaningful. any overlap w/ kv-warmup or prefill?
morgan: overlap with a transient prefill jitter in eu-west, but that was minor. interestingly failures are NACKs and a couple 5xx tokenization errors.
eli: tokenization? did we change tokenizer or vocab in this rollout? config diffs looked clean.
arjun: no tokenizer changes in model version — same model hash. could be request shaping or a batching boundary causing partial KV misses.
ops-oncall: traffic spike in that window? autoscaler logs show a small surge ~+10% rps at 21:35 but not enough to explain 5xx cluster.
morgan: i'm going to rerun a randomized synth with the same seed set and with higher sampling (x3) to see reproducibility.
sasha: I'm +1 for rerun but prefer to nudge sampling to include cold-prefix cases. maybe the sample selector missed cold starts.
morgan: running: ```./deploybot rerun-synth --id 4781 --multiplier 3 --include=cold-prefix --note "reproduce postdeploy cluster"```
deploy-bot: rerun scheduled id=4781-rerun1 started at=1756789085 expected_finish=1756789320
eli: can someone check if the prefix cache TTL changed in this rollout? small TTL change could increase race surface.
arjun: checked infra diff: prefix_cache_ttl unchanged. but rollout did flip continuous-batching backoff from 8ms -> 5ms (performance tweak). could that expose tokenizer race?
sasha: that backoff change can change request coalescing timing. if tokenizer has a non-threadsafe path under heavy coalescing we might see intermittent 5xx. worth checking.
ops-oncall: rerun finished: deploy-bot: id=4781-rerun1 results: samples=600 failed=36 fail_types=[nack:20, tokenization:10, timeout:6] p95_latency_ms=260
morgan: reproduces, same ratio. tokenization errors recurring.
eli: escalation: recommend holding further rollouts of the batching tweak and pin v3.4.6 for non-canary traffic until we triage.
arjun: agreed. what's the rollback vs pin trade here? pinning route to v3.4.6 is quick, rollback is heavier. we should pin the embed-route and run a targeted rollback for the batching tweak.
sasha: propose temporary route pin: embed-route -> v3.4.6, add a canary of v3.4.7 with batching tweak disabled, run extended synth for 30m. if clean, we can re-enable tweak behind a feature flag.
morgan: sounds good. i'll open the pin and include release notes entry. quick command: ```./releases pin-route --route embed-route --version v3.4.6 --reason "postdeploy synth tokenization errors"```
ops-oncall: done — pin created at=1756789120 by morgan. traffic reassignment in progress (~2m).
deploy-bot: pin acknowledged. traffic shifted 95% -> v3.4.6. canary v3.4.7 still receives 5% for extended testing.
eli: next steps for triage: 1) revert batching backoff to 8ms in a dev build and run unit tokenizer stress; 2) add debug logs around tokenizer entry/exit for the canary; 3) run synthetic with varied coalescing intervals.
arjun: i'll take item 1+3. sasha can add the extra logs. morgan keep an eye on canary synth results and slack this thread.
morgan: will do. adding runbook note and a short blurb for release notes: "v3.4.7: temporarily pinned for embed-route after post-deploy synthetic failure cluster; investigating coalescing+batches interaction with tokenizer."
sasha: thanks. one last ask — can we add the failing sample IDs to the incident dataset for offline replay? deploy-bot: exported sample ids to s3://redwood-postdeploy/4781/failures-1756789125.json
morgan: perfect. tagging PMs and customer-facing folks in release-notes draft. will update here when we have root cause.
